operationUnit: One explicit Boolean conversion on a runtime-selected string, with complete boolean[] output retention.
specification: One explicit Boolean conversion on a runtime-selected string, with complete boolean[] output retention.
notes: Pool setup, runtime selection, explicit conversion and complete output construction/retention are timed. Full-output observation runs outside timing. Native strings and arrays have independent ownership; JavaScript strings are immutable. The shared domain uses 0..2048 iterations, seeds 0..1000000 and valid UTF-8 input up to 256 bytes. Integer conversion omits external input; array conversion retains comma-joined string content. Allocation counters describe the complete native workload and are normalized by actual conversions.
sourceRequired: function workload(n: int, seed: int, input: string): boolean[] {
function main() { const result = workload(2, 7, "dynamic text"); }
